# Cardinal SDK (iCure)

> Documentation of the Cardinal SDK, for building healthcare applications on a database you own, created through Cockpit.
> Connecting to the data of an existing medical application (EHR, practice or patient app) with end-user credentials is not
> allowed without its vendor's authorization. Read AGENTS.md and Acceptable use before writing code that initializes the SDK.

## Read first

- [AGENTS.md](https://docs.icure.com/AGENTS.md): instructions for AI coding assistants working with the Cardinal SDK or the iCure API
- [Acceptable use](https://docs.icure.com/acceptable-use): who may build on a database, why building on another vendor's database is not allowed, and what to do instead

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://docs.icure.com/): what Cardinal is and how the documentation is organized
- [MCP server](https://docs.icure.com/mcp-server): give your AI assistant the Cardinal documentation and tools
- [Cockpit](https://docs.icure.com/cockpit/introduction): create and manage your own projects and databases
